topic: Linear Transformations and Matrices: The Geometry of Change

sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Vectors as Points in Space
lecture_lines: Vectors are arrows from origin to a point.
We define space with standard basis vectors.
Unit vectors i and j form the grid.
animations: Label the origin and basis vectors i, j in (#FFFF00).
Animate a vector v as an arrow from the origin (#00FF00) incorporating [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].

sections.title: Defining Linear Transformations
lecture_lines: A transformation moves vectors in space.
Transformation rules: the origin stays fixed.
animations: Transform the grid while keeping lines straight (#FF00FF).
Maintain the origin at (0,0) throughout (#00FFFF) using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg].

sections.title: The Matrix as a Transformation Map
lecture_lines: Any vector is a linear combination.
animations: Display matrix M [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/matrix.svg] with basis vectors i, j (#FFFFFF).
Show how i and j land at new points a, b (#FF00FF) using transformation [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/transformation.svg].
Animate vector x [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vector.svg] as a linear combination of a, b (#00FF00).

sections.title: Visualizing Common Transformations
lecture_lines: Rotation spins vectors around the origin.
animations: Rotate the grid around the origin 90 degrees (#00FF00) using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg] for orientation.
Scale the grid horizontally using a diagonal matrix (#FF0000).
Apply a shear matrix to skew grid lines (#FFFF00) as if viewed through a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/camera.svg].
